_comment: Fixture corpus for FixtureTweetSource. Handles are invented — no real
individual's grievance ships in this repo, per feature-specs/09 and the
social intake plan's S1 risk note.
Times are relative (`minutesAgo`) rather than absolute so the corpus never
ages out of the 6/12/24h windows. Ordering stays deterministic across runs;
Required coverage: a plain grievance, a repeat post from one author, an aged
grievance, an account-closure threat, a regulator threat, and TWO
non-grievances — the negative cases the urgency rules can get wrong.
